scripts.build: VERSION=$(bun -e 'console.log(require("./package.json").version)') && bun build --compile --minify --sourcemap --define SSHM_VERSION="\"$VERSION\"" src/index.ts --outfile sshm
scripts.build:all: bun install --frozen-lockfile --os="*" --cpu="*" && bun run build:linux && bun run build:macos && bun run build:windows
scripts.build:linux: VERSION=$(bun -e 'console.log(require("./package.json").version)') && bun build --compile --minify --sourcemap --target=bun-linux-x64 --define SSHM_VERSION="\"$VERSION\"" src/index.ts --outfile dist/sshm-linux-x64
scripts.build:macos: VERSION=$(bun -e 'console.log(require("./package.json").version)') && bun build --compile --minify --sourcemap --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --define SSHM_VERSION="\"$VERSION\"" src/index.ts --outfile dist/sshm-darwin-arm64
scripts.build:windows: VERSION=$(bun -e 'console.log(require("./package.json").version)') && bun build --compile --minify --sourcemap --target=bun-windows-x64 --define SSHM_VERSION="\"$VERSION\"" src/index.ts --outfile dist/sshm-windows-x64.exe
scripts.format: oxfmt --write src test .github package.json tsconfig.json .oxfmtrc.json .oxlintrc.json commitlint.config.js
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check src test .github package.json tsconfig.json .oxfmtrc.json .oxlintrc.json commitlint.config.js
